scope: Sampling/collection quality audit, not a speech accuracy evaluation. Preserve both attempts and all denominators. No source speech is copied into prediction inputs.

sampling.protocol: First unique native AX heading anchors both browsers without modifying the page or enabling Safari JavaScript automation. Samples body reading after that heading, not the earlier header. AX-text fingerprints are conservative; engine/content differences remain failures. No replacement of failed samples.

model.metadataIssue: Private model-first wrapper omitted casesGeneratedAt. The standard evaluator refused its metadata. Raw metadata was not edited; the archive byte hash and archived generatedAt are independently verified above. Future wrapper metadata must include this field.
